name: isi_pair
label: ISI pair (two 1.65 m trucks), reconfigurable baseline
sources: Hale et al. 2000, ApJ 537, 998: the ISI telescopes are fully mobile (semi-trailers); 4-70 m at Mt. Wilson
notes: The default 100 m East-West pair is a placeholder: load_array('isi_pair', baseline_m=..., pa_deg=...), a campaign's instrument.array_params, or the night-by-night options.baseline_schedule / options.schedule set the configuration.
min_spacing_m 2.5: the trucks cannot park closer than ~2.5 m centre to centre.
